name: us023-event-selects-step
description: 023, Phase 3, US2 (contract lifecycle-event.md §6): the same fixture reconciled under two different events resolves each event's OWN declared step and no other. This capture (SPEC_KIT_JIRA_HOOK_EVENT=after_specify) is COMP-2 already standing at its after_specify target ("To Do", the mock's default status) -- zero availability requests, zero moves. ci-conformance.sh re-runs this same scenario a second time via SPEC_KIT_JIRA_HARNESS_ENV with SPEC_KIT_JIRA_HOOK_EVENT=after_plan, whose OWN declared target ("In Progress") is a reachable, ungated move -- proving the two events resolve two distinct outcomes, not a shared default, on both ports.
